title: Chapter 1360
text:
"Well done!"

Bang!

Seeing the Subduing Tree King explode into fireworks, Simon suppressed the excitement in his heart and smashed the table.

Black Star was still reliable. He had gotten rid of the enemy's key point and stabilized the situation.

Having suddenly lost the halo of the entire army, the World Tree troops' advancement during the enhancement period had instead caused a large number of fleets to fall into a bad situation.

Simon saw the opportunity and quickly calculated for a few seconds before speaking in the command channel.

"All units, pay attention. Press forward!"

When the three Universal Civilizations on the various battlefields received the news, they immediately took action and cooperated with each other, gradually suppressing the enemy fleet.

On the other side, when the World Tree experts saw that the Subduing Tree King had died in battle, there was a slight commotion. Due to the loss of the halo enhancement, their combat strength increased, and the advantage they had previously obtained was quickly reversed by the Beyond Grade As of the three Universal Civilizations.

Without the restriction of the Subduing Tree King, Han Xiao returned to the battlefield where the Beyond Grade As were and attacked the other World Tree experts. Like a tiger entering a pack of wolves, he quickly brought about an overwhelming victory.

Han Xiao's goal was to use the Spacetime Amber to seal the World Tree experts, but it did not go that smoothly. Before the Subduing Tree King self-destructed, he had used the mental network to inform all the high-level combatants of the World Tree present. When the World Tree experts felt that they could not hold on any longer, they self-destructed decisively.

The World Tree knew that their opponent might be the hometown of an outsider, so they naturally would not make a low-level mistake. They did not send any foreign experts to participate in the battle and were still on guard against the virtual purification that they had yet to study.

Even so, Han Xiao had the advantage in terms of strength. After many attempts, he still successfully sealed a target. Before the other party self-destructed, he used thunderous methods to beat him to the brink of death and swallowed him into the amber.

However, this caused the other World Tree experts to self-destruct even more decisively. Several of them even self-destructed while hugging a Beyond Grade A in an attempt to kill their opponent.

With the death of the Subduing Tree King, the scales of the high-level combatants completely tilted towards the three Universal Civilizations. Flames of self-destruction lit up the battlefield.

Not long after, the last Holy Tree Emissary self-destructed and died. Only then did the Beyond Grade As retreat from the battlefield and return to the formation behind the three Universal Civilizations. Almost everyone was injured.

Simon walked up to him and exhaled. His expression was respectful.

"Thank you for your hard work. You guys can rest first. However, the Mechanic still has to provide technical support."

"Okay."

Han Xiao nodded.

The battle was still going on, but what came next was the work of the main fleet. The mission of these high-level combatants was basically completed.

Simon continued, "It's all thanks to you guys this time. We won a complete victory at the high-level combatants level and killed more than a hundred Beyond Grade As from the World Tree. We'll talk about this officially after the battle."

After that, he turned back to the command platform and continued to control the battle. He could not leave for the time being.

The Beyond Grade As exchanged glances and remained silent.

Because of Aurora and Black Star, they only paid the price of six Beyond Grade As to eliminate more than a hundred Beyond Grade As from the World Tree. Just from the perspective of the battle losses, it was indeed a complete victory.

However, life was not a number. Thinking about how their six companions were chatting together not long ago, many Beyond Grade As felt sad for them.

Someone else was sacrificed this time, but the World Tree would always make a comeback. Would I be the next one to die?

Similar thoughts appeared in everyone's minds.

Although they had placed their hopes on Han Xiao's Sanctum Revival, no one dared to guarantee that it would not happen until it was their turn.

Many people were filled with emotions and worry about the uncertainty of the future.

Han Xiao looked back and saw everyone's expressions. He said, "Aurora, you did well this time. If not for you, our losses might have reached more than half."

Hearing this, everyone turned to look at Aurora. Most of them had gratitude in their eyes.

No matter what, most of them had been saved by Aurora more than once today and owed her a favor.

"I was just doing my duty."

Aurora took a deep breath and imitated Han Xiao's modesty.

Her face was rather pale. This high-intensity battle had squeezed out too much of her life energy, and she was almost out of milk.

Hella felt a little heartache, but there was no expression on her face.

Han Xiao patted Aurora's shoulder, looked at everyone, and said, "This battle will take at least a few days. Everyone is injured. Go and rest first."

Hearing this, no one declined and left with their own thoughts, leaving only the direct Beyond Grade As, Manison, Kasuyi, and the other important members of the association.

Manison looked at the four Spacetime Amber at the side. There were four World Tree experts sealed inside.

"What do you plan to do with these four?"

"Seal them first and store them in the interception circle. I'll leave a Throne here to supervise them."

Han Xiao pondered.

He had succeeded four times in using the Spacetime Amber, and he had relied on the huge difference in strength to forcefully control the target before sealing them with the Spacetime Amber. Therefore, the four high-level combatants of the World Tree that he had captured were all ordinary Beyond Grade As. There had been dozens of similar failures, and these were the rare four successful cases. The Executive Officer of the World Tree, the thirteen Ancestral Spirits, and the Army Commander were all very strong and very troublesome to deal with. They self-destructed too decisively, and there was no way to capture them.

The six Beyond Grade As on his side were mainly killed by the self-destruction tactic of the World Tree. The deceased were all ordinary or fragile Beyond Grade As. They died on the spot, and Aurora could not save them in time.

Although he had won the battle between the high-level combatants, Han Xiao also fully felt how difficult it was to deal with the World Tree experts. It was not just their strength, but their synchronized mental network and fearless mentality were the most troublesome parts.

Even though he had many advantages now, the battle-hardened World Tree was still not easy to deal with. He had his methods, but the other party also had various countermeasures.

"Although the Spacetime Amber has already proven its characteristics, we still have to prevent the World Tree from cracking its principles. What we can't do, the World Tree might be able to do."

Manison nodded. He did not dare to be arrogant and say that the World Tree would not be able to crack the Spacetime Amber. To him, this was an unknown.

Han Xiao did not say anything. He turned to look at Hella and gave her a look.

Seeing this, Hella nodded slightly.

This was the secret signal between the two of them. Seeing Hella's performance, Han Xiao knew that Hella had been using the Underworld to collect the souls of the dead. She should have gained a lot, but now was not the time to check.

"World Tree …"

Han Xiao turned around and looked at the battle that was still ongoing. A strange light flashed in his eyes.

…

"Our high-level combatants have won a complete victory. Only six people died. Black Star even used the Spacetime Amber to capture four captives …"

In the joint conference room of the three Universal Civilizations, the three leaders were receiving the frontline battle reports in real time and discussing softly from time to time.

"Black Star is still as strong as ever. Fortunately, he has the help of the association. Otherwise, the direct descendants wouldn't have been able to deal with so many enemies." Louis shook his head.

"Only six people died in battle. The battle results are better than I expected." Marbruce exhaled.

"After destroying this wave of attacks from the World Tree, their next wave shouldn't come so soon. It's bought us more time." The Ethereal Pope nodded.

Although the three of them had the intention of exhausting the association's Beyond Grade As, they were still focused on a common enemy. Seeing that their losses were low, they were also happy.

"However … Hella's Underworld is collecting the souls of our soldiers. This is a problem."

Louis said with a deep voice.

"Now is not the time to care about this." Marbruce lowered his voice.

The existence of the Underworld was no longer a secret. The three Universal Civilizations had already known about it before the war. They knew that Hella might absorb their dead soldiers and talents in the war, but in the current situation, they had no choice but to turn a blind eye.

Although this was suspected of poaching, a large number of soldiers would have died in battle. After entering the Underworld, they would still have a chance to recover, which was equivalent to reducing the loss of their war capital. Now that it was a special situation, the three Universal Civilizations could only acquiesce.

The three of them were also worried that Hella would use the Underworld to take away the dead Beyond Grade As, but at the moment, not many Beyond Grade As were willing to become Heroic Spirits without freedom. Most of them chose to believe in the Sanctum Revival.

However, no matter what, this was a hidden danger. However, now was not the time to care about it. Dealing with the World Tree Civilization was the main problem, and the leaders of the three Universal Civilizations could not do anything about it.

…

The two fleets had been fighting for six to seven days, and the battle line had been stretched extremely long.

The reinforcements of the three Universal Civilizations were endless, and the Beyond Grade As who had finished recuperating would attack together from time to time, causing the battle to gradually lean towards the three Universal Civilizations.

The World Tree expeditionary army was nibbled away in batches, and when the situation was not good, they changed their tactics and no longer attacked head-on. Instead, they spread out and tried to create loopholes in the interception net with their huge numbers.

At this stage of the war, the World Tree's attack had already failed. To the three Universal Civilizations, the only thing left was to clean up the mess.

Although they had defeated the enemy with low losses and won the battle, the upper echelons could not be happy. The revival of the World Tree loomed over their hearts.

However, no matter how heavy their hearts were, the officers still had to command their troops to clean up the mess.

Seeing that the dust had settled, the three Universal Civilizations finally sent the frontline battle report back to the galactic society, announcing their victory and boosting the morale of the people.
